summary: MLB The Show 18 is a baseball video game developed by SIE San Diego Studio and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment, based on Major League Baseball. It is the thirteenth entry in the MLB: The Show franchise and was released worldwide on March 27, 2018, for PlayStation 4. The note also covers its cover stars, a closed alpha test of the online servers, and early access for pre-orders.
one_line: MLB The Show 18 is a 2018 PlayStation 4 baseball video game, the thirteenth entry in the MLB: The Show franchise.
key_facts: MLB The Show 18 is a baseball video game developed by SIE San Diego Studio and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
The game is based on Major League Baseball (MLB).
MLB The Show 18 is the thirteenth entry of the MLB: The Show franchise.
The game was released worldwide on March 27, 2018, for PlayStation 4.
Aaron Judge is featured as the cover star for the U.S. version of MLB The Show 18.
Marcus Stroman is on the cover of the Canadian version of MLB The Show 18.
A limited number of people were invited to a closed alpha of MLB The Show 18.
The closed alpha began on December 22, 2017, and ran until December 26, 2017, to test the online servers.
Pre-ordering players received access to MLB The Show 18 4 days early.
Pre-order players were able to pick up their copy of the game on March 23, 2018.
